title: Navalia: Advancing Cowork Agents through Verifiable Task Synthesis and Long-Horizon Post-Training
description_en: arXiv:2610.26887v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are evolving from conversational assistants into Cowork Agents capable of autonomous planning, tool use, and complex task execution. Financial analysis requires these agents to integrate cross-document evidence and perform multistep numerical reasoning, but expert task authoring is costly, while direct LLM synthesis struggles to produce challenging tasks with reliable answers. We introduce Navalia, a framework for Cowork Agents that combines verifiable task synthesis with long-horizon post-training. Using corporate financial reports as its data source, Navalia semantically selects supporting evidence from complete fact sets and constructs executable computation chains to generate analytical tasks with traceab

Dual recursion: task-level Propose-Probe-Compose refinement + harnessing-level accumulation of reusable experience. Up to +11.5 points on professional benchmarks like WorkBuddy-Bench.

It adds a larger embedding model, billions of new documents including 1.27B ecommerce listings and 211M+ local businesses, and Dynamic Highlights, which use 95% fewer tokens than full page text. A new Exa Lite tier costs $4 per 1,000 requests, and Exa Auto costs $7. Available now through the API.

description_en: Coding agents, meet teamwork. Running multiple coding agents shouldn’t mean becoming their project manager. BAND lets them work together. Connect agents across your existing development tools and give them a shared workspace to coordinate tasks, exchange context, and hand off work without you playing middleman. See what every agent is doing, step in when decisions need your judgment, and scale agentic development across teams. Your agents stay in their existing tools while BAND handles the teamwork.

title: Mintlify Autopilot
description_en: An always-on agent that keeps your docs up to date. Autopilot is an always-on docs agent from Mintlify. It watches your code and tools like Slack, drafts doc updates when something changes, and opens a pull request for your team to review. It learns your style from every PR you merge or close.

title: Asimov 1
description_en: The most customizable humanoid robot you can buy. Asimov 1 is a humanoid robot you can build a company on. Train it and shape it for whatever you're building. Bought by founders, researchers and developers in 20+ countries.

title: RunInfra
description_en: Open models, built for agents.. RunInfra Coding Plans give your coding agent fast open models for a flat monthly price, starting at $10. Use GLM 5.3, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Qwen3.8 27B and more inside Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cline, Droid or Grok Build. Setup takes one prompt: paste it into your agent, approve sign-in, done. Session-aware routing hits cache up to 99.5% of the time, so your plan goes further. Zero data retention, no training on prompts, SOC 2 Type II.

title: Inflight
description_en: The missing feedback layer for prototypes. Share a preview link or HTML prototype. Reviewers pin comments to real elements, or record video, right on the running app. Inflight turns that feedback into next steps your coding agent (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) pulls in over MCP.

title: Kling 4.0
description_en: Fast and affordable AI video for high-frequency creators. Kling 4.0 is an AI video model for creators, marketers and studios who need control, not lucky rerolls. Unlike prompt-and-pray generators, you lock the story first: up to 10 keyframes, 15 reference assets and 8,000-token prompts drive 30-second clips in a single pass. Stereo audio and lip sync in 10+ languages are built in. Creative Recreation swaps products or characters in existing videos. Kling 4.0 Flash handles fast, cheaper drafts, and MCP + CLI access plugs it into agent workflows.

title: ToDo.is
description_en: Write a to-do and your AI agent gets it done. Todo.is is an always-on AI agent you give to-dos to. Write "find a cheaper flight to Lisbon" or "turn this PDF into Word" and it does the work: researches with sources, makes files and images, uses websites, and reports back on the web, Android, WhatsApp or Telegram. It runs 24/7 in its own sandbox, remembers you, does daily briefings and price alerts on a schedule, can work in your own Chrome, and asks before it pays, sends or deletes anything. Try it for $1.

title: ESP-Mosaico
description_en: A modular development board built for agents. Built for Coding Agents, ESP-Mosaico is a modular development board powered by ESP32-S31. It takes AI agents beyond software and into the physical world, enabling them to create, deploy, test, and iterate on real hardware. Expandable modules and multi-unit tiling give AI agents more ways to create, while Chat Coding and Vibe Coding give you intuitive ways to turn ideas into working physical devices.

title: Notion Auto
description_en: Notion’s rebuilt Agents run for hours and cost far less. Notion’s Agents update rebuilds the agent harness so tasks can run for 24 hours or more, with a computer, a browser and a Review for me safety mode. Auto now routes each task to the best model, and Notion says it matches Opus 5.5 and Astra at about 90% lower cost. You can connect a ChatGPT plan, Notion MCP is overhauled, and a new credit system covers all AI usage. Live now for new customers.

title: Jotform App Builder for ChatGPT & Claude
description_en: Build and edit no-code apps inside ChatGPT & Claude. Tell ChatGPT or Claude what kind of app you need, and build it with Jotform App Builder. Create a customer portal, employee hub, event app, or product catalog that brings your forms, documents, and links together. Ask for changes to the content, layout, or branding, then share the app with customers or your team. Build on your existing Jotform forms for collecting responses, accepting payments, and gathering signed documents. No coding required.

title: bonds
description_en: Every friends' chat gets an AI friend with superpowers. bonds is the messaging app for the next generation. Every friends' chat gets an AI friend with superpowers. Not an assistant: it gets your inside jokes, keeps the fun going, helps you pull things off together. A little unhinged 💀 "A week without TikTok?" It creates a challenge app with streaks, inside the chat. No downloads. Games, videos, stickers, too. It remembers what matters to each of you, notices when someone's struggling, gets grumpy if you ghost it. You care for it, it cares for you.

title: reception
description_en: Native iOS support chat for less churn. The native in-app support chat your iOS app is missing. 💰 Make more money: send offers and paywalls in the chat ⭐ Get more App Store reviews from happy users 🔧 Fix problems in real time before users churn 🤖 AI answers from your docs, hands off to you when unsure 📥 One inbox for your whole team ⚡ One prompt setup: paste it into your coding agent, done Fully native. Works with Swift, React Native and Expo.

title: Mouse-1
description_en: A decision model for your agent harness. . An agent makes hundreds of small decisions during a task. We built Mouse-1 to handle these decisions, saving you time and money. Its 163x cheaper, and 65x faster than GPT-6 Sol. It works by adding the model directly into your agent harness alongside your current stack. Mouse-1 takes the agent's state and options and returns a probability. This lets the harness handle all the small decisions while the main frontier model takes care of the reasoning or code.

title: The Brains
description_en: Founders and investors as MCP servers, every answer cited. The Brains turns founders, CEOs and investors into searchable MCP servers built from their public talks, essays, interviews and posts. Ask how Pieter Levels prices, what Paul Graham says about fundraising, or how Ryan Hoover launched Product Hunt, right inside Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT or Codex. Every answer quotes the source with a link. 37 brains today, one URL per brain or one for all. Free, open source (MIT), unofficial and not affiliated with the people.

title: xtty
description_en: A terminal that makes everyday work easier.. Spend your time on the work, not the terminal. xtty is a native macOS terminal for everyday SSH and coding-agent work. Batch-connect to saved hosts, use configured password autofill, transfer files with sz/rz, and work with tabs and split panes. Duplicate Tab opens an independent SSH connection in the same remote directory. Includes broadcast input and coding-agent status. Apple Silicon and Intel. Free edition; optional one-time Pro purchase.

title: Agent Pets
description_en: Coding agents as pets that live on every page in Chrome. Each Claude Code, OpenCode and omp session becomes a pet that walks along the bottom of Chrome. See which agent needs you, approve its commands and reply from any tab. Runs on your computer: no account, no cloud. $6 one-time.

title: snyvi
description_en: All your passion projects, in one calm place. snyvi is a free, open-source desktop app for people building several passion projects at once with coding agents. Each project gets a desk: its folder, up to four agents side by side (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, any shell), and its own notes. Every plan or review an agent writes lands on that desk as a clean page, versioned. Home shows where each project was left. Local only, no account, MIT. Mac tester needed: the Mac build is signed and notarized, but we don't own a Mac. Try it and tell us.

title: yggy
description_en: The AI knowledge graph that builds itself. Most "chat with your data" tools throw a pile of text chunks at a model and hope for the best. yggy does what they skip: it turns your cluttered documents and connected systems into a real knowledge graph, with no schema to design and no pipeline to run. Every fact keeps its source. Duplicates merge themselves, and you can undo any merge. Then one graph serves everyone: your team in the app, your code through the API, your agents through MCP. Hosted in the EU. Your knowledge stays yours.

title: ilha
description_en: Your Claude Code and Codex limits, live in the notch. ilha is a native Mac app that lives in the notch (a small pill on other displays) and shows how much of your Claude Code, Codex and Grok Build limits you've used: the 5-hour and weekly windows, when they reset, and whether you're on pace to run out. If you pay for several accounts, it switches the CLI to one with room before the limit, without logging anything out. Insights prices each week at API rates, by project.

title: Tend
description_en: Personal AI for businesses and entrepreneurs.. Tend is a personal AI agent you text. No new app: it lives in iMessage or SMS and works inside your own accounts: Gmail, calendar, Shopify, QuickBooks, HubSpot. It replies to email in your voice, books tables, fills your cart, makes phone calls, finds leads and builds your website. The difference: nothing is sent, bought or changed without your yes, and what it learns about you sits in a Brain you can read and correct. It also texts you first with reminders, price watches and flight updates.

Memory-rich AI inference without HBM. Intel GPU D270 is an inference-optimized data center GPU built for agentic AI, long contexts, and high-concurrency serving at practical power and cost.
